messages:
Noah Rivera: Hey team, just set up at my desk (SF-12) and the USB-C -> Ethernet dongle is missing from my kit. Monitor, dock, cables present though. :disappointed_relieved:
it-support-bot: Sorry about that, Noah. I've opened IT-5044 and pinged Logistics. Can you share the SKU on the packing slip? Also, did the foam pouch come empty?
Noah Rivera: SKU: REDW-EMP-0426. Foam pouch was empty. No outer box pic, I recycled it already.
Jules Park: Welcome Noah! Quick temporary workaround: tether to phone hotspot and enable USB tethering. If you're on mac, run `networksetup -listallhardwareports` to find the interface. I can also drop by with a spare dongle from the office stash around 2pm.
Noah Rivera: Thanks Jules, that'd be awesome. I'll be at SF-12 all afternoon.
Logistics Bot: Replacement accessory requested (EXPEDITE). Tracking will be posted here in ~1 hour. Ref SHIP-100998. ETA 2 business days.
Facilities: Noted a couple of kits this week with missing accessories. Filing a QA ticket for packing crew. Thanks for flagging the empty pouch.
Noah Rivera: Appreciate it. Do I need to keep anything boxed up for returns?
it-support-bot: No return needed for missing parts. Keep any foam/labels for 48h in case Logistics asks for photos. When replacement arrives, plug it in and run `ifconfig` (mac) or `ipconfig /all` (win) and paste a short output if you hit issues.
Noah Rivera: Got it. Will mark ticket resolved here once I test the replacement or Jules drops off a loaner. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
